sloka: जगाम महतीम् चिन्ताम् धर्म साध्वस शन्कितः ।पर दार अवरोधस्य प्रसुप्तस्य निरीक्षणम् ॥५-११-३७॥
transliteration: jagāma mahatīm cintām dharma sādhvasa śankitaḥ ।para dāra avarodhasya prasuptasya nirīkṣaṇam ॥5-11-37॥

translations.english: 'Observing the wives of others in this manner in their inner chambers very much amounts to transgression of moral code by me'. ( thought he)
